quest.title: Omni-Ubiquity Net
quest.description: Sango says that her friend would like to modify the Ubiquity Net...
quest.rewards_formatted: Omni-Ubiquity Net x10, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Ugh, that Wakamurasaki... I shouldn't have let her know about Kageroumaru...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Oh, hello there, Traveler. Do you still remember the Ubiquity Net, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: After we settled the previous incident, I explained all that happened to a friend of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Her name is Wakamurasaki, and she's... Well, she calls herself a "designer."

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: She was quite inspired by the manner in which you used the net.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: So she's been badgering me this whole time to help her look up new techniques with which she can continue modifying the Ubiquity Net...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: I couldn't deal with all that nagging, so I did find her something new in that ancient collection of mine...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: If the fancy takes you, Traveler, go to her place. If I don't miss my guess, she's probably finished her modifications by now.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: Well, that should certainly do it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello there, are you Wakamurasaki?

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: That's me! What do you need?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I'm here about the Ubiquity Net...

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: Oh, are you? ...Ohh, I remember now. You must be that Traveler! Sango told me about you.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: The way in which you operated that Net was truly impressive. Inspiring, in fact!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've heard that you've been modifying it.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: Aye, that's right! Hehe... Sango dug up an all-new Onmyou technique for me and all!

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: I used that technique to modify this net once again, and I name this new model the "Omni-Ubiquity Net"!

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: According to Sango, this technique is able to detain the essence of living creatures before using certain objects as media to recreate the shape of that living being.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: She even says that the utmost achievement of such an Onmyoudou technique is to recreate a human essence!

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: Such essences can answer questions and will never lie.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: I must say that such a technique would be of unbelievable help to a detective like Sango!

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: You know what? I actually think that's why she told me about that technique and allowed me to make changes to the net...

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: Ah, ah! But don't you go around telling anyone that. I'm only telling you this because you and Sango are friends, alright?

response.speaker: Wakamurasaki
response.text: No matter how I modify it, this net can only be used to recreate the essences of small creatures. It has no effect on humans whatsoever.

response.speaker: Wakamurasaki
response.text: You know what, Traveler? Take this net with you. Who knows, seeing you in action might give me some inspiration again!

response.speaker: Wakamurasaki
response.text: Here, take it with you — and remember, it's the Omni-Ubiquity Net now, not just the Ubiquity Net!

response.speaker: Wakamurasaki
response.text: Go on, then, go catch a few lil' animals to test it out!

talks.objective: Use the Omni-Ubiquity Net to capture small animals

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: How did it go? Well?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was a one-and-done...

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: Hmm... I suppose that was inevitable...

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: Like I said before, this technique can detain the essence of a small animal, but if you want to retain that essence and recreate that animal, you will need a separate medium.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: I integrated those techniques into the Net, such that it is also the essence-retention device and the recreation medium.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That sounds... complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: Well, basically, each net can only be used once.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: This is an issue that I haven't been able to solve yet, either. If the medium can't stand repeated use, the cost of this device will be way too high...

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: I'll continue doing research into this net and try to fix the problem as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: If you still need Omni-Ubiquity Nets, you can come find me.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: And uh... even though these nets can catch small animals, they're a bit of a fuss to put together...

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: So, next time you want one of these nets, you'll have to pay me a nominal fee.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: Relax! You're Sango's friend, I won't charge you too much. You'll get a good rate, I promise!

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Did you find Wakamurasaki?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, here's the deal with the Omni-Ubiquity Net...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: "Omni-Ubiquity Net"... You know what? It's not a bad name. Still, that technique...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can that technique really detain a human's essence?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Uh, no. That's not possible.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: There are only records of such an onmyoudou technique existing. Any practicum has long disappeared into the mists of time.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: The technique that I taught Wakamurasaki can only do that for small animals.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, then why didn't you tell her?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Oh, that? I just wanted Wakamurasaki to help me spread a certain something around.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: "Bantan Sango Detective Agency's president is currently asking someone to create a net using Kamuna Onmyoudou that can make people tell the truth."

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: The long-lost Kamuna Onmyoudou, the Bantan Sango Detective Agency, and a net that can indeed detain the essences of small creatures.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Put all three together, and you have an urban legend that both sounds impressive, and that actually has a grain of truth to it.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: For most people, these urban legends are just little stories... But for criminals who already have the seed of fear in their hands, such tales are not so simple.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ah, so that's how it is...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: The other side of it is... Well, Wakamurasaki was starting to get on my nerves with that whole "find me the strongest onmyoudou technique ever!" nonsense.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: I told her many, many times that such things don't exist, but she wouldn't listen! So I had no choice but to give her *something* to work with so she'd get off my back.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if Wakamurasaki doesn't tell anyone about this?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Im-possible. She couldn't keep a secret to save her life. Trust me, I know her waaay too well...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Either way, thanks for making the trip on my behalf. Take this. Consider it payment for the errand run.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Archon, I hope she doesn't come to bother me again. I'm a detective you know? Not some onmyouji...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: If the fancy takes you, Traveler, go to her place. If I don't miss my guess, she's probably finished her modifications by now.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: Go on, then, go catch a few lil' animals to test it out!
